title: Eugene Sedric on the boat with Fate Marable
summary: Eugene Sedric played with Marable and is still going strong in New York.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Remember the names and different things like that. Let's see. Who else came off the boat that was outstanding? This saxophone player and carnet player used to be with Fat Swallow. Gene Cedric?
Yeah, Gene Cedric. Little Fat Follower. That's him.
Yeah. I saw him in New York about a year ago, a little over a year ago.
He was very good when he was on the boat.
Still playing. All right. Still going strong. Do you remember if he was with Fade or was that? Yes, he played with Fade. He was with Fade, not with him.
That's right. Fade with Fade. Eugene, Cedric.
